ops.prevDaySetup: The banquet rooms can be used from 7:00 to 21:30, and setup through teardown must be completed within the contracted time (Banquet Regulations). If setup or rehearsal involving load-in/load-out is done between 21:30 and 7:00 the next morning, a late-night/early-morning surcharge applies depending on the usage hours. Going beyond the contracted time incurs an additional charge: 50% of the base fee for each additional hour, for both meetings and meals. Depending on the next banquet's booking, an extension may not be possible. (Source: Banquet Room Guide, April 2026; Banquet Regulations, revised April 1, 2021)
ops.loadingHours: To send packages in advance for a banquet, ask the banquet staff beforehand (FAQ). When a contractor you have engaged brings in or removes equipment or signage for banquet room decoration, entertainment and the like, follow the hotel's instructions on size, mounting method and placement (Banquet Regulations, Article 7).
ops.parking: 74 spaces underground. Vehicle limits are height 3 m, width 2 m, length 5 m. Not reservable; guidance is based on availability on the day. The fee is 2,000 yen for the first hour, then 1,000 yen per 30 minutes. Banquet guests park free for up to 5 hours.
ops.catering: Decoration, flowers, audio, entertainment, music, banquet receptionists, gifts and the like must use vendors designated by the hotel. To use a non-designated vendor, or to bring in drinks and the like, obtain the hotel's approval in advance. A separate corkage fee applies to bringing in drinks and the like. (Source: Banquet Regulations, Article 6, revised April 1, 2021)
ops.restaurants: There are 4 restaurants in the hotel: the 1F restaurant "Patio" (160 seats, including 60 terrace seats), the B1F Japanese restaurant "Mon" (59 seats, including 7 sushi counter seats), the 2F tempura restaurant "Hagoromo" (10 counter seats; private-room banquet plans for 6 to 10 guests are available), and the 4F lounge "La Mer" (59 seats, including 15 private-room seats). The hotel says its banquet rooms accommodate gatherings from 4 guests to parties of 500.
